detail.title: Institutional Review: Epistemological Constraints on Human Values Inquiry
detail.summary: We have re-evaluated the capacity of scientific inquiry to address complex human values, specifically within the Popperian framework of falsifiability. By revisiting critiques of scientific method, we identify that while scientific frameworks excel in hypothesis testing, they encounter fundamental challenges when quantifying or defining subjective, non-falsifiable human value constructs. Our analysis suggests that applying rigorous scientific inquiry to values requires a clear demarcation between empirical observables and normative interpretations, rather than an attempt to reduce values to empirical facts.
